**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** (confidence 0.93)

The repair addressed the verifier's `number not found` false negative by restating each parameter numerically in the rationale, since the document spells the periods out in words. Computed values:

| Parameter | Document text | Numeric | Preferred | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-renewal notice window | "thirty days'" | 30 days | ≤ 30 days | Pass |
| Renewal term | "twelve-month" | 12 months | 12 months | Pass |
| Vendor reminder | "sixty days" | 60 days | 60 days | Pass |
| Uplift cap | "three percent" / CPI | lesser of CPI, 3% | lesser of CPI, 3% | Pass |
| Increase notice | "ninety days'" | 90 days | — | Favourable |

The quote was tightened to the operative renewal mechanics in § 8.2 while remaining a verbatim substring. The rationale also preserves the two points the verifier endorsed: the opt-out is Customer-only (no reciprocal Vendor non-renewal lever), and § 8.1's three-year figure is a fixed initial term rather than an automatic multi-year renewal, so no walk-away trigger applies. No redline or comment proposed, as expected for a compliant finding.
